title: Exterior doors.
officialText:
Where an exterior door is nonmetal or nonmetal-clad, such door shall be covered with a kick plate of a
minimum thickness of 0.033 inch (0.84 mm), extending at least 8 inches (203 mm) from the bottom of the door, and covering the
entire width of the door. When closed, the maximum clearance between any door, door jambs and sills shall not be greater than 3/
8
inch (9.5 mm).
